+"""Hand-check sheet for LLM cluster labels: `export` writes review.xlsx, `apply` reads it back."""
+import json, sys
+import pandas as pd
+from dynamite.cluster import embed, cluster
+from dynamite.label import central
+
+
+def export():
+    posts = [json.loads(l) for l in open("data/posts.jsonl")]
+    X = embed(posts); lab = cluster(X, 15)
+    labels = pd.read_csv("data/cluster_labels.csv")
+    rows = []
+    for _, r in labels.iterrows():
+        ex = [posts[i]["text"][:200] for i in central(X, lab, r.cluster, n=5)]
+        rows.append({**r.to_dict(), **{f"example_{j + 1}": e for j, e in enumerate(ex)}, "verdict": "", "my_label": ""})
+    pd.DataFrame(rows).to_excel("data/review.xlsx", index=False)
+
+
+def apply():
+    rv = pd.read_excel("data/review.xlsx").fillna("")
+    bad = rv[~rv.verdict.isin(["ok", "rename"])]
+    if len(bad):
+        sys.exit(f"{len(bad)} rows without a verdict: clusters {bad.cluster.tolist()}")
+    rv["final_label"] = rv.apply(lambda r: r.my_label if r.verdict == "rename" else r.label, axis=1)
+    rv[["cluster", "size", "final_label", "label", "verdict"]].to_csv("data/cluster_labels_final.csv", index=False)
+    print(f"{(rv.verdict == 'rename').sum()} renamed, {(rv.verdict == 'ok').sum()} kept")
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    {"export": export, "apply": apply}[sys.argv[1]]()
*** End Patch
